data.name: Vakil
data.gender_notes: Vakil is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who advises or represents others in legal matters. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'vakula', which means 'to speak' or 'to advise'. The name Vakil carries the meaning “Lawyer, advisor, scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vakil usually hope their child will grow to embody lawyer, advisor, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and the ability to provide guidance and protection.
data.etymology: Vakil belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lawyer, advisor, scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vakil total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
